act_title: The Dock Workers (Safety, Health and Welfare) Act, 1986
title: Short title, extent, commencement and application
text:
1. Short title, extent, commencement and application.—(1) This Act may be called the Dock

Workers (Safety, Health and Welfare) Act, 1986.

(2) It extends to the whole of India.

(3) It shall come into force on such dateas the Central Government may, by notification in the

Official Gazette, appoint.

(4) It shall not apply to any ship of war of any nationality.
